content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. content_sections.heading: AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Consultant- Public Health: Master in Public Health (MPH) with at least 3 years' experience OR MD (Community Medicine) with at least 2 years' experience. Preference shall be given to prior experience in Health Systems at Central/State Level. Senior Research Fellow: Post Graduate Degree in Public Health/Epidemiology/Health Management/ Health Economics/ Population Science, including the integrated PG degrees, with 2 years post qualification Experience. Preference shall be given to prior experience in Health Systems at Central/State Level. Project Technical Support-III (Administrative Support): Three Years Graduate degree with three (3) years post qualification experience in Govt. accounting. OR Chartered Accountancy (CA) and Cost and Management Accountancy (CMA) intermediate pass. Experience in computer and having experience in handling national and international programmes.

content_sections.text: Walk-in interview Decision of selection committee further to approval of Director, AIIMS Bhubaneswar will be final. Result will be published on AIIMS Website after the selection process is over.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment is for a walk-in interview, and the interview is scheduled for 19 September 2026. Candidates should report on this date with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for Research Project posts at AIIMS Bhubaneswar. These include positions for Consultant- Public Health, Senior Research Fellow, and Project Technical Support-III.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Consultant- Public Health post?
faq.answer: For the Consultant- Public Health position, candidates need a Master in Public Health (MPH) with at least 3 years of experience or an MD (Community Medicine) with at least 2 years of experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Senior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Research Fellow position is 35 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Project Technical Support-III post?
faq.answer: The Project Technical Support-III post offers a salary of Rs. 33,600/- per month, which includes 20% HRA. This is a project-based role.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Based on the provided information, no application fee is mentioned for any category of candidates applying for these positions.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for these project-based vacancies?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a walk-in interview. The final decision will be made by the selection committee and approved by the Director of AIIMS Bhubaneswar.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the walk-in interview for AIIMS Bhubaneswar Recruitment 2026 be held?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify the exact venue for the walk-in interview. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for the complete address and reporting details.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should candidates bring for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates should bring two photocopies of their application form and supporting documents, along with original documents for verification. This includes ID proof, educational certificates, and experience certificates.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, these are project-based vacancies at AIIMS Bhubaneswar. The recruitment is for an extramural funded research project on a tenure basis.
